label_revision_scope: XML schema-location correction; no numeric data revision
citation: Prettyman, T.H. (2012), Lunar Prospector GRS Elemental Abundance, NASA Planetary Data System; numerical analysis in Prettyman et al. (2006), doi:10.1029/2005JE002656.
rights_scope: Public mission data restored locally by URL/hash; raw archive and documentation remain ignored, with no redistribution approval inferred. Derived numeric analysis records credit and source identity.
metadata_cautions: The XML Table_Character generic name says 2 degrees; filename, product description and spatial bounds identify the 5-degree product.
Six oxides do not sum exactly to one; original values are not normalized.
The covariance matrix uses mixed mass-fraction and ppm coordinate units.
Formal covariance omits systematic errors and does not establish independent spatial pixels.
